messages:
marta: Heads-up — since ~05:20 UTC we're seeing lots of EU GPU nodes stuck in PROVISIONING. errors in the node agent: 'kms:Decrypt failed' + conntrack timeouts. new pool expansion halted. @arjun can you triage?

arjun: I'm on it. first glance looks like a KMS permission flap + some weird SNAT exhaustion on the staging NAT.

marta: repro steps: triggered a scale up from the autoscaler, instance boots, node-agent logs show: `failed to unwrap key: AccessDenied` then `dial tcp <kms-ip>:443: i/o timeout` on the same attempt.

sam: FYI audit-bot reported a config push to the KMS policy at 04:58 from rachel. Could be related. audit-bot, can you surface the PR?

audit-bot: PR #4127 merged by rachel at 04:57 (infra/kms): tightened kms:Decrypt to specific role ARN and removed legacy cross-account allow.

rachel: that was intentional to lock down the old bootstrap role. I added a migration step but maybe the new node role wasn't updated in time.

arjun: I'm seeing a handful of nodes with the old instance profile still attached. guessing some ASG launch configs cached the old profile. also seeing conntrack counters spike on the NATs — lots of half-closed connections to KMS endpoints causing SNAT table pressure.

kevin: NAT capacity is hitting ~97% conntrack on eu-west-1-b, we've had similar during cert rotations. Ops runbook suggests rotating ephemeral NATs or enable additional nat-proxies. Want me to spin new small NAT group and update route table?

marta: yes please spin. in parallel we need a rollback plan for the KMS policy if nodes can't get keys.

rachel: I can revert the PR to widen the Decrypt permission back to the bootstrap role for a short window. but prefer to patch node role mapping so new instances get correct profile.

sam: for rollback: rachel revert + force-redeploy node bootstrap IAM mapping. that should be quick. But if SNAT exhaust is killing connections, nodes might still fail even with permissions.

arjun: quick mitigation: 1) create new NATs and shift LB traffic (kevin), 2) revert KMS tighten (rachel), 3) enforce launch-template replacement for the ASG (marta) to pick up new role. Doing 1+2 now.

ops-bot: incident annotated: #INC-2026-334 created by marta — EU gpu provisioning degraded. not a Sev1.

kevin: spun 2x t3a-nat proxies in eu-west-1-b and attached to route table for the worker-subnet. conntrack dropped from 97% -> 45% in 80s. latency to KMS improved.

arjun: after NAT shift I can see successful TLS handshakes to KMS from new nodes. Decrypt errors gone for fresh launches. Existing stuck nodes still waiting on role change.

rachel: reverted PR and re-opened follow-up to add explicit mapping + migration plan. pushed revert at 06:12 UTC.

marta: rolling ASG update now to replace instances. will monitor.

sam: adding note — we should run a small synthetic KMS stress test during role migrations next time to catch conntrack exhaustion. also add NAT autoscaling to runbook.

arjun: Verified provisioning healthy for new nodes post-update. Existing stuck nodes recovered after ASG replace. marking this as mitigated.

marta: thanks all. action items: (1) rachel add migration mapping + test, (2) ops add nat autoscale/runbook, (3) arjun audit existing launch-templates for stale profiles. I'll follow up in infra retro. :thumbsup:

kevin: logging: `/var/log/node-agent.log` snippets and conntrack counters attached in the incident ticket.

audit-bot: Audit trace: KMS policy change and revert recorded. Adding 90d review reminder.

rachel: will follow up with a postmortem note in #postmortems later today.

marta: closing thread here — re-open if we see reoccurrence.
